about: A personal and family travel organizer for trips, stays and travel plans.

prs.title: Hotel stays count the right number of nights
prs.broken: The lodging stats rounded the time of a stay up, so checking in at 11:00 and out at 15:00 two days later counted as 3 nights.
prs.changed: Nights are now counted by the calendar days a stay crosses. A stay inside one day still counts as one night.
prs.matters: Travel stats show the nights people actually stayed.

prs.title: Travel Board travel time now counts time zones
prs.broken: Travel time just subtracted the two local times, so a 7 hour flight from New York to London counted as 12 hours.
prs.changed: When both ends have a time zone, each time is now read in its own zone.
prs.matters: Travel stats show how long trips really took.
